lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.unitTitle: Taking Care of My Own Space
lessonRef.title: Explicit model: the five-minute tidy

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice the five-minute tidy. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The learner picks one small, real space, such as their bedroom floor or a corner of a shared playroom, sets a timer for five minutes, and runs through the four-step routine once while a family member is nearby but not doing the tidying for them.
materials: adult-or-local: one real space that needs tidying

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe one specific difference between your space before and after the five-minute tidy.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Step order: All four steps are completed in the modeled order. | Completion within time: All four steps are completed at or near the five-minute mark. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner run the same five-minute tidy in a second space the next day and compare, in writing, which of the two spaces was faster to tidy and why.

resources.title: the five-minute tidy worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner picks one small, real space, such as their bedroom floor or a corner of a shared playroom, sets a timer for five minutes, and runs through the four-step routine once while a family member is nearby but not doing the tidying for them.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact the five-minute tidy decision or action.
Model move 2: Before starting the timer, look at your space and picture how it will look when you are done.
Model move 3: Set a timer for five minutes and run the four steps in order: pick up floor items, clear flat surfaces, put items back where they belong, then do one last visual scan.
Model check: Step order: All four steps are completed in the modeled order. | Completion within time: All four steps are completed at or near the five-minute mark.

resources.title: the five-minute tidy action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for the five-minute tidy.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: the five-minute tidy coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner picks one small, real space, such as their bedroom floor or a corner of a shared playroom, sets a timer for five minutes, and runs through the four-step routine once while a family member is nearby but not doing the tidying for them.
Coach direction: Before starting the timer, look at your space and picture how it will look when you are done.
Learner prompt: Name the one spot in your space that looks the messiest right now.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: the five-minute tidy complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Set a timer for five minutes and run the four steps in order: pick up floor items, clear flat surfaces, put items back where they belong, then do one last visual scan.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I picked up every item on the floor first, before touching surfaces.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I cleared off at least one flat surface, like a desk or dresser top.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I put items back in a specific home, not just a different pile.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I did one last visual scan of the whole space before stopping the timer.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: the five-minute tidy minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe one specific difference between your space before and after the five-minute tidy.
Success checks: Step order: All four steps are completed in the modeled order. | Completion within time: All four steps are completed at or near the five-minute mark.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: the five-minute tidy supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional the five-minute tidy condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Step order: All four steps are completed in the modeled order. | Completion within time: All four steps are completed at or near the five-minute mark..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: the five-minute tidy — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the the five-minute tidy task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Describe one specific difference between your space before and after the five-minute tidy.
observableCriteria: Step order: All four steps are completed in the modeled order.
Completion within time: All four steps are completed at or near the five-minute mark.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Step order: All four steps are completed in the modeled order. | Completion within time: All four steps are completed at or near the five-minute mark.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
